name: processtask_extend_formattribute
label: Work Order and Form Extension Attribute Value Relationship Table
description: The table connects workflow-related association queries and report queries to the extended attribute values of forms and work orders.

fields.name: processtask_id
fields.description: Work order ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: form_attribute_data_id
fields.description: Form attribute values ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the processtask_id, form_attribute_data_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
